One stop for tyres and the car on top of them

Overseas Tyre is a Michelin dealer and car workshop on Jalan Indah 16/11 in Taman Bukit Indah, Johor Bahru. Drive in for new tyres, wheel alignment and balancing, a regular service, brakes or suspension, and wait in the air-conditioned room while the bay does the work.

  • Michelin dealer

    Listed on the Michelin Malaysia dealer locator. Continental tyres and sport rims too.

  • Hunter tyre changer

    Wheels are fitted on a Hunter machine in our own bay.

  • Clear explanations

    Our technicians show you what is wrong, with video when it helps.

Michelin and Continental tyres

New tyres supplied and fitted, punctures repaired, worn sets replaced. Bring the size on your sidewall or just your car model.

WhatsApp usMore about this service

Fitted on a Hunter machine

Every wheel goes on the Hunter tyre changer in our bay, then gets balanced before it goes back on your car.

Wheel alignment and balancing

Pulling to one side or a shaking wheel? We set the alignment on the rack and balance each wheel.

Regular car servicing

Engine oil, lubricants and general maintenance, done on the lift in the same visit as your tyres.

Brakes, shock absorbers and suspension

Brakes, shock absorbers and suspension parts checked under the car and replaced when they are worn.

How a tyre job goes

Four steps, one visit.

  1. WhatsApp us

    Send your car model and year, and your tyre size if you have it.

  2. We inspect and recommend

    We check your tyres and wheels, then tell you what you need and why.

  3. Fit, balance and align

    New tyres go on the Hunter changer, each wheel is balanced, then the alignment is set.

  4. Collect your car

    We show you what was done, you pay and drive off.

Questions drivers ask

Where is Overseas Tyre?

At 2, Jalan Indah 16/11, Taman Bukit Indah, 81200 Johor Bahru, Johor. Open Google Maps or Waze from this page for directions.

What are your opening hours?

Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday, 9:30am to 7:30pm. We are closed on Wednesdays.

Which tyre brands do you fit?

We are a Michelin dealer and also supply Continental tyres. Ask us on WhatsApp for your size.

How do I get a quote?

WhatsApp 018-234 1322 with your car model, year and tyre size if you know it.

Need tyres or a service this week?

Send your car model and year on WhatsApp. We reply with what it needs.
